flags.model_excerpt: మీరు వైజాగ్ నెమ్బర్ ఇస్తారా వాట్సాప్లో చేద్దామ్ ఒకసారి
flags.model_translation: Will you give your Vizag number, let's do it on WhatsApp once
flags.model_justification: Proposing to move to an external app and asking for a phone number matches a strong PlatformMove case.
flags.model_context: They were discussing locations, and the user asked for a WhatsApp number to chat. The expert responded about chatting on WhatsApp.

flags.model_excerpt: పెయిడ్ మీట్ ఏమన్నా అఊతారా అనీ బుద్ధిగానె పెయిడ్ మీటౖ ఏమన్నా అఊతారేమోనని చెప్పి అడుగుత్నాను
flags.model_translation: Asking if you'll do a paid meet, just asking if you'll do a paid meet
flags.model_justification: Proposing to meet in person matches a strong PlatformMove case.
flags.model_context: The user talks about ending the call earlier and then brings up meeting in person as a paid meet.

flags.model_excerpt: ఫోటో నేను హాయ్ పెడతాను వాట్సాప్లో ఫో ఫోటో పమ్పింపణ్డి ఎంతో చెప్పణ్డి
flags.model_translation: I will send hi on WhatsApp, send a photo and tell how much
flags.model_justification: Proposing to move to WhatsApp matches a strong PlatformMove case.
flags.model_context: The user asks for a number to connect on WhatsApp and exchange photos.

flags.model_excerpt: లేకపోతే మీరు ఫోటో కాపోతె వీడియో కాల్ చేయ్ండి
flags.model_translation: Otherwise you, if not photo, make a video call
flags.model_justification: Asking to show on video matches a strong Explicit-Flirting case.
flags.model_context: The user discusses seeing photos or doing a video call to see each other.
